chapter: Paris, Lester Young, drugs, Mississippi and later sessions
title: Ray Nance forms his own group; Scoops Carey joins Collins's mother's band
summary: After high school Nance formed his own small group, while Grissom went to Lunceford and Scoops Carey replaced him with the mother's group.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional

blocks.x: They were the only ones who paid, really. Yeah, they were the only ones who paid. But any way, this is the time that Ray had his band. After high school he had this -- most of the kids would go with Erskine Tate, or you know, some bands around there. But Ray formed his own small group. And really did very well, yes. So as I told you

then Grissom worked with us and then he left us and went to Lunsford. And this is when we got Scoops Carey to come with us, then he started playing with my mother and he took Dan's place. He couldn't sing but he played so beautifully, you know.
